datasets.title: Infrastructure Climate Resilience Assessment Data Starter Kit for Aruba
datasets.description: Starter data kit collecting extracts from global, open datasets relating to climate hazards (coastal and river flooding, extreme heat and drought, tropical cyclone wind speeds) and infrastructure exposure systems (population, built-up area, roads, railways, power infrastructure) for Aruba. Derived from global datasets clipped to national boundaries to support climate risk analysis and infrastructure resilience assessment.
datasets.purpose: To kickstart climate risk analysis and act as a starting point for infrastructure resilience assessment, vulnerability analysis, and scenario development, particularly for low and middle-income countries where access to data is a barrier.
datasets.details: This data starter kit addresses barriers to climate risk analysis by collecting and processing global, open datasets. Extracts are clipped to national scale using Natural Earth (2023) boundaries. The spatial intersection of hazard and exposure datasets provides a foundation for analyzing vulnerability and risk to infrastructure and people. Related tools include snkit for network data cleaning and nismod-snail for infrastructure exposure and risk calculations. Funded by the FCDO Climate Compatible Growth Programme.

resources.title: Coastal Flood Hazard Maps (Aqueduct Floods)
resources.description: Coastal flood inundation depth maps for multiple climate scenarios (historical, RCP4.5, RCP8.5) and future time periods (2030, 2050, 2080), with return periods ranging from 2 to 1000 years. Filename pattern: inuncoast_{scenario}_{subsidence}_{year}_rp{return_period}_0__ABW.tif (e.g., inuncoast_historical_wtsub_2050_rp0100_0__ABW.tif, inuncoast_rcp4p5_wtsub_2080_rp0500_0__ABW.tif). Total 90 GeoTIFF files.

resources.title: River Flood Hazard Maps (Aqueduct Floods)
resources.description: Riverine flood inundation depth maps for historical baseline and multiple climate models (GFDL-ESM2M, HadGEM2-ES, IPSL-CM5A-LR, MIROC-ESM-CHEM, NorESM1-M) under RCP scenarios (RCP4.5, RCP8.5) for future time periods (2030, 2050, 2080), with return periods from 2 to 1000 years. Filename pattern: inunriver_{scenario}_{model}_{year}_rp{return_period}__ABW.tif (e.g., inunriver_historical_000000000WATCH_1980_rp00100__ABW.tif, inunriver_rcp4p5_0000GFDL-ESM2M_2050_rp00500__ABW.tif). Total 279 GeoTIFF files.

resources.title: Extreme Heat and Drought Hazard Maps
resources.description: Annual probability of extreme heat and drought events derived from ISIMIP climate projections. Includes multiple climate models (GFDL-ESM2M, HadGEM2-ES, IPSL-CM5A-LR, MIROC5) under RCP scenarios (RCP2.6, RCP6.0) for time periods (2030, 2050, 2080), plus historical baseline. Filename pattern: lange2020_{hydrological_model}_{climate_model}_{forcing}_{scenario}_{soc}_{co2}_{variable}_{temporal_range}_{period}_occurrence__ABW.tif (e.g., lange2020_lpjml_ipsl-cm5a-lr_ewembi_rcp60_2005soc_co2_led_global_annual_2006_2099_2050_occurrence__ABW.tif). Metadata file: isimip_heat_drought.csv. Total 245 GeoTIFF files and 1 CSV.

resources.title: Tropical Cyclone Wind Speed Return Periods (STORM)
resources.description: Tropical cyclone wind speed return periods for historical and climate change scenarios using STORM dataset. Includes multiple climate models (CMCC-CM2-VHR4, CNRM-CM6-1-HR, EC-Earth3P-HR, HadGEM3-GC31-HM) with return periods from 10 to 10000 years. Filename pattern: STORM_FIXED_RETURN_PERIODS_{model}_{return_period}_YR_RP__ABW.tif (e.g., STORM_FIXED_RETURN_PERIODS_CMCC-CM2-VHR4_1000_YR_RP__ABW.tif). Metadata file: storm.csv. Total 136 GeoTIFF files and 1 CSV.

resources.title: Road Network Infrastructure (OpenStreetMap)
resources.description: Road network data extracted from OpenStreetMap including tertiary roads and above. Files: openstreetmap_roads-tertiary__ABW.gpkg (GeoPackage format) and openstreetmap_roads-tertiary__ABW.osm.pbf (OpenStreetMap Protobuf format).

resources.title: Railway Network Infrastructure (OpenStreetMap)
resources.description: Railway network data extracted from OpenStreetMap. Files: openstreetmap_rail__ABW.gpkg (GeoPackage format) and openstreetmap_rail__ABW.osm.pbf (OpenStreetMap Protobuf format).

resources.title: Power Plants (Global Power Plant Database)
resources.description: Power generation facilities including location, capacity, and generation information from the Global Power Plant Database. File: wri-powerplants__ABW.gpkg.

resources.title: Population Distribution (GHS-POP)
resources.description: Global Human Settlement population grid for years 2020 and 2025 from the European Commission Joint Research Centre. Files: GHS_POP_E2020_GLOBE_R2023A_4326_30ss_V1_0__ABW.tif and GHS_POP_E2025_GLOBE_R2023A_4326_30ss_V1_0__ABW.tif.

resources.title: Built-up Area (GHS-BUILT-S)
resources.description: Global Human Settlement built-up surface grid for years 2020 and 2025 derived from Sentinel-2 and Landsat, from the European Commission Joint Research Centre. Files: GHS_BUILT_S_E2020_GLOBE_R2023A_4326_30ss_V1_0__ABW.tif and GHS_BUILT_S_E2025_GLOBE_R2023A_4326_30ss_V1_0__ABW.tif.

resources.title: Supporting Files and Metadata
resources.description: Additional supporting files including national boundary (boundary__ABW.geojson), analysis grid (grid__ABW.gpkg), targets raster (targets__ABW.tif), flood metadata (aqueduct_flood.csv), heat/drought metadata (isimip_heat_drought.csv), cyclone metadata (storm.csv), and datapackage descriptor (datapackage.json).
